tools.name: check_api_status
tools.description: Call the Zernio health endpoint and return its JSON response. Use to verify the API is up before attempting a call.

tools.name: get_openapi_spec_url
tools.description: Return URLs for Zernio's OpenAPI spec, MCP server card, API catalog, and agent skills index (the machine-readable resources for building against Zernio).

tools.name: list_supported_platforms
tools.description: Return the list of social platforms and ad networks Zernio supports. Useful when the user asks 'does Zernio support X'.

tools.name: open_docs
tools.description: Open the Zernio API documentation at docs.zernio.com. Use when the user asks how to integrate, authenticate, or call a specific endpoint.

section.description: Optional docs section path, e.g. 'core/posts/create-post' or 'platforms/instagram'.

tools.name: start_free_trial
tools.description: Send the user to the Zernio sign-up flow to create a free account and obtain an API key.

tools.name: view_pricing
tools.description: Navigate to the Zernio pricing page.
